files.description: 8-page PDF documenting the 170.315(b)(10) EHI Export feature. Describes single-patient and multi-patient export workflows, and the ZIP file structure including CSV files (billing, demographics, schedule), C-CDA XML, HTML encounter notes, and document attachments. Version 1.0, dated October 14, 2023.
